problems.title: big
problems.starterCode:
def factorial(n):
    result = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result *= i
    return result


def is_prime(num):
    if num < 2:
        return False
    for i in range(2, int(num ** 0.5) + 1):
        if num % i == 0:
            return False
    return True


def fibonacci_series(count):
    series = []
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(count):
        series.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return series


def main():
    print("=== Factorial Table ===")
    for n in range(1, 6):
        print(f"{n}! = {factorial(n)}")

    print("\n=== Prime Numbers up to 20 ===")
    primes = [x for x in range(2, 21) if is_prime(x)]
    print(primes)

    print("\n=== Fibonacci Series (10 terms) ===")
    fib = fibonacci_series(10)
    print(fib)

    print("\n=== Sum of Fibonacci Series ===")
    total = sum(fib)
    print("Sum =", total)

    print("\n=== Average of Fibonacci Series ===")
    average = total / len(fib)
    print("Average =", average)

    print("\nProgram finished successfully.")


if __name__ == "__main__"
    main()
